rules.title: Tinnitus
evidence_tips: Describe onset and persistence (constant vs intermittent) in a clear timeline.
Document noise exposure history: MOS, weapons ranges, flight line, engines, IEDs, or training events.
Include lay statements describing when ringing started and how it affects sleep, focus, or work.
List treatments tried (hearing protection, audiology visits, masking devices).
Include any audiology records that mention tinnitus complaints.

rules.title: Migraines / Headaches
rating_criteria: 10% - characteristic prostrating attacks averaging 1 in 2 months over last several months.
30% - characteristic prostrating attacks occurring on an average once a month over last several months.
50% - very frequent completely prostrating and prolonged attacks productive of severe economic inadaptability.
evidence_tips: Keep a headache log: date, duration, severity, and whether it was prostrating (had to lie down).
Document work impact: missed days, reduced hours, productivity loss, or accommodations.
Include ER or urgent care visits related to headaches.
List medications (prescribed and OTC) and note side effects.
Provide lay statements describing how attacks affect daily life and ability to function.

rules.title: PTSD / Trauma-related condition
rating_criteria: Ratings are based on occupational and social impairment (symptoms and functional impact).
Document frequency, severity, and duration of symptoms.
evidence_tips: Describe functional impact at work, home, and relationships with specific examples.
Include treatment notes, therapy notes, and medication history.
Provide buddy or family statements describing observable symptoms and changes over time.
Document sleep disruption, panic episodes, avoidance behaviors, or hypervigilance.
Include disciplinary actions, performance issues, or job loss tied to symptoms if applicable.

rules.title: Sleep Apnea
rating_criteria: 0% - asymptomatic but with documented sleep disorder breathing.
50% - requires use of breathing assistance device such as CPAP.
100% - chronic respiratory failure with carbon dioxide retention or cor pulmonale, or requires tracheostomy.
evidence_tips: Include sleep study results (AHI, diagnosis, date).
Provide CPAP prescription and compliance reports if available.
Document daytime sleepiness, fatigue, and safety impact (driving, work).
Include buddy statements describing loud snoring, witnessed apneas, gasping, or choking.
Note any related conditions (hypertension, headaches, depression) as possible secondary issues.

rules.title: Thoracolumbar spine condition
rating_criteria: Ratings often depend on range of motion, functional loss, flare-ups, and neurologic symptoms.
Document limitations: lifting, standing, sitting, bending.
evidence_tips: Provide ROM measurements from exams and note pain on motion.
Describe flare-ups: frequency, duration, triggers, and functional limits.
Include imaging (X-ray, MRI) and physical therapy notes.
Document radiculopathy symptoms (shooting pain, numbness, weakness).
Provide lay statements about daily limitations and missed work or activities.
